configurePresets.name: windows-clang
configurePresets.description: Use clang-cl on Windows so the parity flags (-ffp-contract=off, -Wall/-Wextra) are honored — MSVC cl silently drops them, risking numeric drift.

configurePresets.name: dev
configurePresets.description: Pure ported algorithms + pybind oracle + Catch2 tests. No ffmpeg/ORT/server. Builds on a fresh checkout with zero system deps.

configurePresets.name: audio
configurePresets.description: Adds the in-process libav* decode + ONNX Runtime compute chain. Needs system ffmpeg dev libs.

configurePresets.name: server
configurePresets.description: The C++ replacement for the Python Flask app/. Audio + oat++ + curl + libarchive + keychain.

configurePresets.name: server-vcpkg
configurePresets.description: Same as 'server' but resolves ffmpeg/curl/libarchive/onnxruntime from vcpkg. Requires VCPKG_ROOT.

configurePresets.name: server-macos
configurePresets.displayName: Server on macOS (arm64, CoreML EP available)
configurePresets.description: Same as 'server' on Apple Silicon. sherpa downloads the official ORT osx-arm64 prebuilt, which already bundles the CoreML EP — no extra flag. See docs/MACOS_COREML.md.

configurePresets.name: server-cuda
configurePresets.displayName: Server + CUDA ONNX Runtime EP (native, Linux/native CUDA)
configurePresets.description: 'server' built with the GPU ORT (WHISPERX_ENABLE_GPU). Needs a CUDA toolkit + GPU. System heavy deps (gcc/clang honor the parity flags).

configurePresets.name: server-vcpkg-cuda
configurePresets.displayName: Server + CUDA via vcpkg + clang-cl (the Windows GPU path)
configurePresets.description: GPU ORT build resolving heavy deps from vcpkg and using clang-cl on Windows. Requires VCPKG_ROOT + CUDA toolkit + cuDNN. See docs/WINDOWS_CUDA.md.
